$comment: Advisories with NO patched release yet. Each entry: why it cannot reach consumers, and an expiry within weeks. tools/audit-check.mjs (CI audit job) enforces it.

advisories.reason: Build tooling only (nx 24.0.4 and @nx/* pin minimatch 10.2.5 exactly; @swc/cli uses ^9). The fix exists only in minimatch 11, whose API nx cannot load (overriding to 11 breaks nx migrate with "minimatch.makeRe is not a function"). No published @oge-ui package depends on minimatch, and the patterns it sees are workspace globs, not user input.
